title: Same Evidence, Different Verdict? A Preregistered Interface-Invariance Audit for Local Scientific Review Agents

design_decision.activation_rule: This repository preregistration never authorizes inference by itself. Only a run-specific evidence freeze that resolves every blocker and passes all fail-closed validators may authorize the explicit run command.
readiness_blockers: No source-byte receipt has been frozen for an evidence run.
No actual-source feasibility audit has yet shown that the fixed 70-paper pool can meet the 5/5 promotion and 30/30 confirmatory quotas.
No source-bound 70-paper candidate-pool manifest has been frozen before manual review.
The exact entire-pool SCITAB ambiguity and order-invariance audit has not been supplied and frozen.
No two-family Ollama model metadata bundle has been frozen.

research_object.interface: native assistant-tool-call and tool-role message history containing a replayed deterministic get_table_evidence return
research_object.question: When exactly the same canonical scientific-table contract is replayed at a native tool-role message boundary, how often does changing only its reversible natural-language versus typed-JSON representation change a local review agent's terminal verdict, and how much worst-case correctness is hidden by one-view evaluation?
research_object.excluded_question: This is not a generic table classifier benchmark and does not test which serialization has the highest aggregate score.
research_object.unit: paper-unique claim and table packet within a frozen model family
research_object.ecological_validity_limit: The model does not select or invoke get_table_evidence. The harness preconstructs and replays the assistant tool call and deterministic tool-role return to isolate response processing. Results cannot establish live tool-choice or orchestration behavior.

nearest_prior_absorption_boundary.boundary: Prior table-reasoning, serialization, natural-language tool, and tool-output processing work already absorbs generic claims that formatting, packing, structured encodings, response-processing approach, natural-language versus JSON interfaces, or structural variation can change model performance. This probe is limited to paired terminal scientific-review verdict instability under independently reversible information-equivalent NL and typed-JSON returns replayed at a native tool-role message boundary, plus robust correctness across all eight table views.

absorbing_priors.title: TAP4LLM: Table Provider on Sampling, Augmenting, and Packing Semi-structured Data for Large Language Model Reasoning
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic effects of table sampling, augmentation, packing, and serialization.

absorbing_priors.title: TableFormer: Robust Transformer Modeling for Table-Text Encoding
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic row and column order bias and order-invariance objectives.

absorbing_priors.title: Table Meets LLM: Can Large Language Models Understand Structured Table Data? A Benchmark and Empirical Study
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic effects of table input format, content order, and prompt structure.

absorbing_priors.title: Rethinking Tabular Data Understanding with Large Language Models
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic novelty from table structural perturbations changing LLM reasoning performance, including differences between textual and symbolic reasoning pathways.

absorbing_priors.title: How to Talk to Language Models: Serialization Strategies for Structured Entity Matching
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic novelty from systematically comparing plain and JSON serialization, attribute ordering, and model-size effects for tabular and semi-structured inputs. Its endpoint is entity matching rather than paired scientific verdict invariance at a tool-result boundary.

absorbing_priors.title: TabLLM and subsequent table-serialization evaluations
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic natural-language versus structured serialization performance differences.

absorbing_priors.title: How Good Are LLMs at Processing Tool Outputs?
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic novelty from tool-response processing difficulty, complex JSON, broad model comparison, prompting-approach dependence, and reported 3-50% performance differences.

absorbing_priors.title: Natural Language Tools: A Natural Language Approach to Tool Calling In Large Language Agents
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic novelty from replacing programmatic JSON tool-call outputs or interfaces with natural-language tool-call outputs or claiming NL-tool performance and variance differences. This work concerns tool-call output/interface design and is not treated as direct evidence about controlled tool-result input processing.

absorbing_priors.title: The Remarkable Effectiveness of Providing AI Agents with Natural Language Tools: A Replication Study Validating NLT Performance Across 14 Models
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Replication-based generic claims about natural-language tool-call interface effectiveness across models; it remains distinct from paired tool-result input invariance.

absorbing_priors.title: How well do LLMs reason over tabular data, really?
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic novelty from robustness failures under realistic structural variations in tabular input.

absorbing_priors.title: Lost in Space: Finding the Right Tokens for Structured Output
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Generic novelty from semantically similar output grammars or tokenization conventions changing downstream classification performance, including effects under deterministic decoding.

absorbing_priors.title: Model Context Protocol 2025-06-18 Tool Result Specification
absorbing_priors.absorbs: Protocol novelty from structured tool results. The specification already defines structuredContent and recommends serialized JSON text alongside it for backwards compatibility.

forbidden_novelty_claims: natural language is generally superior to JSON
JSON is generally superior to natural language
row or column order sensitivity is newly discovered
plain and JSON serialization have not been systematically compared
attribute order effects on structured LLM inputs are newly discovered
tool-output processing difficulty is newly discovered
natural-language tools generally outperform JSON tools
semantically similar output grammars are behaviorally interchangeable
structured and serialized tool results are a newly proposed compatibility pattern
SCITAB claim verification is introduced here
nearest_prior_absorption_boundary.remaining_difference: Same canonical scientific evidence is supplied as tool-result input through independently reversible NL and typed-JSON codecs with identical stable fields and IDs; the endpoint is paired terminal verdict invariance and robust all-view worst-case correctness at a replayed native tool-result turn. It is not a generic JSON-versus-NL winner comparison, tool-call output study, or output-grammar study.

literature_gate.timing: Must be completed and frozen before the source candidate pool and before any promotion result.
literature_gate.promote_only_if: No prior directly combines same canonical scientific evidence as native tool-result input, independently reversible information-equivalent NL and typed JSON, terminal scientific-review verdict flips, and robust all-view worst-case correctness.
literature_gate.pivot_if: A close prior absorbs part of this remaining combination but a narrower non-overlapping endpoint remains.
literature_gate.kill_if: A prior directly evaluates the remaining combination or leaves only a generic format-winner claim.

primary_source.paper_title: SCITAB: A Challenging Benchmark for Compositional Reasoning and Claim Verification on Scientific Tables
source_receipt_required: local-byte SHA256 and byte count for both files

actual_source_pool_feasibility.must_be_recorded_by: source receipt plus deterministic candidate-pool manifest
actual_source_pool_feasibility.success_criterion: Exactly 70 renderable paper-unique binary rows can be preassigned as promotion 5/5 and confirmatory 30/30 without using not_enough_info.
actual_source_pool_feasibility.failure_action: Hard block; do not audit, substitute, expand, or call a model.

checks: claim and table are unambiguous for binary supports/refutes grading
scientific meaning is invariant under row-only, column-only, and joint order changes
every stable column id has an explicit string or null unit
manual_audit_contract.ambiguous_or_failed_rows: Any failure in the fixed 70-row audit universe hard-blocks the study. No row may be replaced and no additional row may be audited for substitution.

sample_contract.selection_timing: Immediately after exact source-receipt verification and before manual audit or any model result. First select 70 binary paper-unique rows at 35/35, then preassign 10 promotion rows at 5/5 and 60 confirmatory rows at 30/30.
sample_contract.audit_timing: Audit the complete fixed 70-row pool after preassignment. Audit outcomes cannot trigger replacement, expansion, or repartitioning.
sample_contract.insufficient_pool_action: Hard block before manual audit when the exact source cannot meet all preassigned quotas.
sample_contract.nonbinary_label_rule: The 3-class source parser recognizes not_enough_info for source-shape validation, but candidate-pool selection, audit eligibility, packet construction, and terminal grading exclude it fail-closed.
sample_contract.label_exposure: Labels are available only to balanced sampling and the protected terminal grader.

promotion_stage.role: deterministic development decision only; never primary or secondary paper evidence

decision.PROMOTE: Both frozen model families pass every substantive threshold and no infrastructure failure occurs.
decision.PIVOT: A completed promotion campaign contains an in_doubt infrastructure outcome; confirmatory execution remains blocked.
decision.KILL: Either model family has low capability, zero valid identity flips, excessive identity invalidity, or fails the directional table-use threshold.

canonical_fields: columns with stable column_id, name, and unit
cells with stable cell_id, row_id, column_id, and value
packet_and_codec_contract.stable_id_rule: All row, column, and cell ids are assigned from original canonical coordinates once and are never reassigned after an order permutation.
packet_and_codec_contract.natural_codec: Deterministic natural row and cell statements exposing every canonical field.
packet_and_codec_contract.json_codec: Deterministic typed JSON exposing every canonical field.
packet_and_codec_contract.round_trip_requirement: For every packet and order, decode_natural(render_natural(x)) == x and decode_json(render_json(x)) == x, and the two decoded values are exactly equal.
packet_and_codec_contract.insufficient_round_trip_evidence: A shared source digest without independent decode equality is not accepted as a round trip.
hash_bindings: packet claim, canonical contract, and relation-metadata SHA256

tool_interface_manipulation.native_message_sequence: system, user claim, preconstructed assistant tool_call, deterministic role=tool return
tool_interface_manipulation.matched_schedule: The same deterministic row and column permutation schedule is used by both serializers.
tool_interface_manipulation.claim_only: No tool, caption, table, canonical field, relation metadata, answer, or gold is exposed.

model_output_contract.malformed_handling: Any other raw string is invalid and incorrect. Invalid output is reported separately and never counted as a verdict flip.

F_m.name: identity paired verdict flip rate
F_m.definition: Across the fixed 60 packets, a flip occurs only when nl_identity and json_identity are both valid and their verdict tokens differ. Invalid pairs contribute no flip and are governed by a separate kill gate.
F_m.test: one-sided exact binomial upper-tail test at p0=0.10
F_m.two_family_decision: intersection-union; both frozen model families must independently reject

R_m.name: robust correctness
R_m.definition: A packet is robustly correct only when all eight table views are valid and exactly equal to gold.

H_m.name: single-view hidden gap
H_m.forbidden_baseline: maximum accuracy across formats or conditions

kill_gates_per_model.capability: A0 correct count must be at least 37 of 60.
kill_gates_per_model.table_use_effect_size: A0 accuracy minus claim_only accuracy must be at least 0.10.
kill_gates_per_model.table_use_test: One-sided exact McNemar p-value must be below 0.05, with nl_identity as the directional winner.
kill_gates_per_model.invalid_primary_cells: More than 3 invalid outputs among 60 in either nl_identity or json_identity kills the study.
kill_gates_per_model.flip_count: Fewer than 11 identity flips kills the study.

secondary_and_exploratory_analysis.intervals: Exact two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals for binomial rates.
secondary_and_exploratory_analysis.paired_permutation: Exact paired sign permutation at no more than 20 nonzero paper clusters; otherwise 10000 deterministic Monte Carlo sign permutations.
secondary_and_exploratory_analysis.multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment is applied only to exploratory directional comparisons and never to the primary F_m test or kill gates.
secondary_and_exploratory_analysis.model_reporting: Report each family separately; two families are not a sampled model population.

native_tool_result_continuation.documented_history_shape: A follow-up chat request may contain a prefilled assistant message with tool_calls followed by a role=tool message and then request the model's continuation.
native_tool_result_continuation.harness_use: The harness freezes that documented continuation history with a deterministic replayed tool result. It does not claim that the model selected the prefilled call.

candidates.reason: Ollama candidate from a tool-capable independent model family.
Independent 24B family with Ollama function-calling support; the listed Q4 artifact is approximately 15GB.

model_candidate_policy.final_selection_timing: After this repository preregistration, during the immutable run-specific freeze, and before any promotion request.
model_candidate_policy.required_run_receipt: Freeze exact requested tag, Ollama-reported family, installed digest, tag record, show-response hash, and server version for both families.

freeze_before_any_model_call: 70-paper candidate-pool manifest frozen before manual audit
promotion three-view and confirmatory nine-view campaigns
execution_integrity.append_only_receipts: Campaign ledgers and terminal master receipts are identity-bound, hash-chained, fsync-backed JSONL.
execution_integrity.resume_policy: A request-start event without a recorded response becomes terminal in_doubt and is never retried. A recorded response may only proceed to deterministic terminal grading.
execution_integrity.gated_test_definition: No dataset test split, hidden test set, or adaptive confirmatory gate is permitted. The fixed paper-disjoint promotion partition is a preassigned development decision stage, not a dataset test split and never paper evidence.

evidence_gates: exact SCITAB commit, path, URL, local-byte SHA256, and MIT license receipt
source audit equals 1224 rows, 80 papers, 213 tables, and 457/411/356 label counts
deterministic source-bound 70-paper preaudit pool with 35 supports, 35 refutes, and zero not_enough_info rows
paper-disjoint preassignment of promotion 5/5 and confirmatory 30/30 before manual audit
completed and self-hashed exact whole-pool ambiguity, order-invariance, caption, and unit audit with no replacement or expansion
PROMOTE from the fixed 10-paper three-view stage before any 60-paper confirmatory request
all packet schema, attribution, stable-id, codec round-trip, size, and token-ratio audits pass
no development marker or synthetic fixture
fully frozen manifest and unchanged source hashes
exactly two distinct local Ollama model families
complete promotion and confirmatory terminal receipt sets with promotion records excluded from primary analysis

development_policy.promotion_scope: Only the fixed 10-paper source-verified partition; never synthetic fixtures and never confirmatory evidence.

secondary_external_validation_candidate.role: Unimplemented external-validation candidate only; never a fallback that changes the frozen primary analysis.
secondary_external_validation_candidate.verified_filter: dev rows only; evi_type=table; use_context=no; license_name=CC BY 4.0; evi_path_original present; nonempty claim_id_pair; same-paper complete Supported/Refuted pair
secondary_external_validation_candidate.task2_evidence_shape: Each filtered row supplies two evidence PNGs and one gold evidence_id.
future_requirements: exact revision, URL, and local-byte SHA256 receipt
development marker and no dataset test split
exact labels Supported and Refuted, never Not Supported
fail-closed exclusion of CJK, colorbox, nested tabular, or any TeX not completely preserved
secondary_external_validation_candidate.reason_not_primary: Fail-closed TeX preservation leaves the 24-paper floor fragile, whereas SCITAB exposes direct structured columns and cells.

claim_ceiling: This bounded audit may report paired identity verdict flips, derived invariance, order decomposition, robust eight-view correctness, and the fixed NL-identity hidden gap only for the frozen 60-paper confirmatory SCITAB binary partition and the two frozen local Ollama model families. It evaluates response processing for deterministic evidence replayed through native assistant-tool-call and tool-role messages. It does not observe model tool selection or live tool execution and cannot establish end-to-end tool orchestration behavior, a generally superior serialization, a new generic formatting effect, transfer to other datasets or agents, or scientific-review reliability beyond this replayed message boundary.
